title: Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations, 2014

regulations.heading: Obligation to Apply on Prescribed Forms
regulations.text:
Access to biological resources shall be made through standard forms:
- Form I: Access to biological resources and associated traditional knowledge for commercial utilization or bio-survey.
- Form II: Transfer of results of research to foreign entities.
- Form III: Applying for Intellectual Property Rights (Patents) in or outside India.
- Form IV: Third-party transfer of accessed biological resource.
regulations.relevance: Procedural compliance roadmap for AYUSH innovators.

regulations.heading: Benefit Sharing Options on Sale of Product
regulations.text:
The applicant shall pay to the NBA/SBB benefit sharing on annual gross ex-factory sale of product:
- Up to Rs. 1 Crore: 0.1%
- Rs. 1 to 5 Crores: 0.2%
- Above Rs. 5 Crores: 0.5%
Alternatively, 3.0% to 5.0% of the purchase price of the biological resource.
regulations.relevance: Exact formula to compute commercial benefit-sharing costs for Ayurvedic startups.

regulations.heading: Benefit Sharing on Commercialization of Patents / IPR
regulations.text: Where the applicant commercializes the patent himself, the benefit sharing shall be 0.2% to 1.0% on ex-factory sale. Where the applicant assigns or licenses the patent to a third party, the benefit sharing shall be 3.0% to 5.0% of the royalty received, or 2.0% to 5.0% of the license fee.
regulations.relevance: IP licensing royalties distribution to local biodiversity management committees (BMCs).
